decision: Integrate Forward+ per-sector pair shader selection; keep the full Natural shader on every sector with junction influence in its complete one-tile halo. Other renderers retain the previous sampler.
design: Reuse immutable transition metadata; cache each 16x16 tile sector classification while its map field exists. Do not infer uniformity from a camera view.
The halo includes all four relief taps and map bounds. Full junction geometry, warping, donor selection and sampling arithmetic remain intact.
One shared additional ShaderMaterial per terrain references the original textures. No new texture, material atlas, geometry, draw, map asset or user-facing setting.
Water levels, rain cover and caustic scroll propagate to both shared materials. Live option changes copy all current parameters.
Sector source meshes retain current base materials through subdivision, cache overrides and real footprint deformation. Dense footprint receivers keep the full sampler.

environment.isolation: Private XDG profiles. No other Godot engine observed during timings. The desktop renders on GPU0; GPU1 retains inactive ComfyUI/Xorg allocations. pmon/dmon retained. No desktop, driver clocks or unrelated process was modified.
environment.timing: Both shaders prewarmed, then ABBA with 256 warmup and 480 sampled normal frames per arm. Use measured viewport GPU timestamps. Offload presentation adds wall-clock overhead; clocks were not locked.

limits: Viewport terrain work is not full-game FPS. The user Windows RTX4090 Mobile/default renderer remains untested; this does not establish a fix for the reported 9 FPS case.
1440p prototype timings varied with GPU clock changes and do not establish a general gain at that resolution. Repeated 4K close and mixed-section measurements are the qualified cost evidence.
Only statically eligible sectors use the simpler shader; occupied junction sectors and deformed receivers still use the complete path.

The fixed-four-material-loop variant retained two strict one-pixel failures and no repeatable saving, and remains excluded. Earlier Natural texture-cache/metadata-sharing and cloud experiments remain unpromoted.
Cloud cost, V1 cold preparation/numerical residuals, broader target-device performance, WAN and full campaign routes remain open. This is not stable-release acceptance.
